_note: v2.7 plan 39 (NOT YET RUN; row 36-Q5-scn-b, beside 36-Q5-scn): a quest reward with host effects. Discovery (/cp set accepted), completion (/cp set rang_bell on the reply the boundary sits on) lands the reward once: the run's own test entry 'SO-Q5 bell rung' in 'SO-V27-36Q5 Lore' (created here through applyProvisioning, removed at the end by the assets verb) switches on and Arin is muted (cast_changes disable), the mute with a quest-origin cast ledger row (the entry rides the path replay with the rewarded quests: world info is never ledgered, plan 36 §Gate). A same-chat reopen keeps both and equals the continuous run. A swipe of the completing reply takes all of it back: entry off, Arin enabled, every quest-origin ledger row 'reverted', the quest active again; a second reopen equals that replayed state with the host unchanged. The toy group's disabled_members is checked through expect.groupDisabled before and at the end; if the revert fails, Arin stays muted in the lane's group until the next run's requires.members re-enables her. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v27-36-quest-rewards.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; return true;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); return { cleared: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const book = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'createStoryLorebook', name: 'SO-V27-36Q5 Lore' }, { requirements: { lorebooks: [] } }); if (!book.ok && !book.message.includes('already exists')) throw new Error('could not create the test lorebook: ' + book.message); const entry = await rt.applyProvisioning({ kind: 'upsertLorebookEntry', lorebook: 'SO-V27-36Q5 Lore', comment: 'SO-Q5 bell rung', keys: ['bell'], content: 'The harbour bell has been rung.', constant: true }, { requirements: { lorebooks: ['SO-V27-36Q5 Lore'] } }); if (!entry.ok) throw new Error('could not write the test entry: ' + entry.message); return { book: book.ok, entry: entry.ok };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); if (!rt.getSnapshot().requirements?.ready) throw new Error('requirements not ready: ' + JSON.stringify(rt.getSnapshot().requirements)); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(200); } }; const entry = async () => { const book = await (await fetch('/api/worldinfo/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'SO-V27-36Q5 Lore' }), cache: 'no-cache' })).json(); const found = Object.values(book?.entries ?? {}).find((row) => row.comment === 'SO-Q5 bell rung'); if (!found) throw new Error('the test entry is missing from the book'); return found; }; const arinMuted = () => { const live = SillyTavern.getContext(); const group = live.groups.find((candidate) => candidate.id === live.groupId); const avatar = live.characters.find((character) => character.name === 'Arin')?.avatar; if (!group || !avatar) throw new Error('the toy group or Arin is missing'); return (group.disabled_members ?? []).includes(avatar); }; const questRows = () => (rt.getSnapshot().effects?.ledger ?? []).filter((row) => row.origin?.kind === 'quest'); const status = () => (rt.getSnapshot().gameAuthor?.quests ?? []).find((quest) => quest.id === 'bell')?.status; const saved = async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 100 && rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null; i += 1) await pause(100); if (rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null) throw new Error('the last boundary is not saved, so a reopen would legitimately differ'); }; const reopen = async () => { const chatId = SillyTavern.getContext().chatId; await SillyTavern.getContext().reloadCurrentChat(); await until(() => rt.getSnapshot().storyId === 'so-v27-36-quest-rewards', 10000, 'the story to hydrate after the reopen'); if (SillyTavern.getContext().chatId !== chatId) throw new Error('the reopen moved the page'); rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await pause(1500); }; globalThis.__q5 = { pause, until, entry, arinMuted, questRows, status, saved, reopen }; await until(async () => (await entry()).disable === true, 10000, 'the gated reward entry to start disabled'); if (arinMuted()) throw new Error('Arin is muted before the reward'); return { status: status() };

steps.slash: /sendas name=Arin The harbour bell has not rung in years.

steps.eval: const q5 = globalThis.__q5; if (q5.status() !== 'active') throw new Error('discovery: expected the quest active, got ' + q5.status()); const titles = (globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().game?.quests ?? []).map((quest) => quest.title); if (!titles.includes('The harbour bell')) throw new Error('the discovered quest is not on the player surface: ' + JSON.stringify(titles)); if (q5.questRows().length) throw new Error('a reward row exists before completion: ' + JSON.stringify(q5.questRows())); return { status: q5.status(), titles };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" You haul on the rope and the bell swings.

steps.eval: const q5 = globalThis.__q5; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await q5.until(async () => (await q5.entry()).disable === false, 15000, 'the reward entry to switch on'); await q5.until(() => q5.arinMuted(), 15000, 'the reward to mute Arin'); const values = rt.getEngineState().blackboard.values; if (values.quest_bell_closed !== 'done' || values.quest_bell_rewarded !== true) throw new Error('the quest did not close with its reward: ' + JSON.stringify({ closed: values.quest_bell_closed, rewarded: values.quest_bell_rewarded })); const rows = q5.questRows(); if (rows.some((row) => row.effect === 'world_info')) throw new Error('a world_info reward was ledgered (plan 36: world info is never ledgered, it rides the path replay): ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); if (!rows.some((row) => row.effect === 'cast' && row.status === 'applied')) throw new Error('expected an applied quest-origin cast row from the reward: ' + JSON.stringify(rows.map((row) => [row.effect, row.status]))); globalThis.__q5.completedAt = rt.getEngineState().lastMessageId; if (globalThis.__q5.completedAt !== SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length - 1) throw new Error('the completing boundary is not on the last message'); await q5.saved(); return { completedAt: globalThis.__q5.completedAt, rows: rows.map((row) => [row.effect, row.status]) };

const q5 = globalThis.__q5; await q5.reopen(); if ((await q5.entry()).disable !== false) throw new Error('the reopen switched the reward entry off'); if (!q5.arinMuted()) throw new Error('the reopen un-muted Arin'); if (q5.questRows().some((row) => row.status !== 'applied')) throw new Error('the reopen changed the reward rows: ' + JSON.stringify(q5.questRows().map((row) => [row.effect, row.status]))); return { status: q5.status() };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = ctx.chat.length - 1; if (last !== globalThis.__q5.completedAt) throw new Error('a message landed after the completing reply'); const reply = ctx.chat[last]; if (reply.is_user) throw new Error('the completing message is not a reply'); reply.swipes = [reply.mes, 'You reach for the rope, then let it go.']; reply.swipe_id = 0; reply.swipe_info = [{}, {}]; await ctx.saveChat(); return { swipeable: last };

const q5 = globalThis.__q5; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await q5.until(async () => (await q5.entry()).disable === true, 15000, 'the swipe to switch the reward entry off'); await q5.until(() => !q5.arinMuted(), 15000, 'the swipe to un-mute Arin'); const values = rt.getEngineState().blackboard.values; if (values.quest_bell_closed !== undefined || values.quest_bell_rewarded !== undefined || values.rang_bell === true) throw new Error('the swipe did not rewind the completion: ' + JSON.stringify({ closed: values.quest_bell_closed, rewarded: values.quest_bell_rewarded, rang: values.rang_bell })); if (q5.status() !== 'active') throw new Error('after the swipe the quest should be active again, got ' + q5.status()); const rows = q5.questRows(); const left = rows.filter((row) => row.status !== 'reverted'); if (!rows.length || left.length) throw new Error('every quest-origin ledger row should be reverted: ' + JSON.stringify(rows.map((row) => [row.effect, row.status]))); await q5.saved(); return { rows: rows.map((row) => [row.effect, row.status]) };

const q5 = globalThis.__q5; await q5.reopen(); if ((await q5.entry()).disable !== true) throw new Error('the reopen switched the reward entry back on'); if (q5.arinMuted()) throw new Error('the reopen muted Arin again'); if (q5.questRows().some((row) => row.status !== 'reverted')) throw new Error('the reopen re-applied a reward row: ' + JSON.stringify(q5.questRows().map((row) => [row.effect, row.status]))); return { status: q5.status() };
